agentComment: We've now had four weeks of strong online interest but enquiry has eased and buyer feedback at the last two opens consistently placed value at the lower end of our range. My recommendation is to adjust the advertised range down to $1,600,000 – $1,690,000 to re-engage the qualified buyers who've inspected. Happy to talk this through on Monday.
